item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested","findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Digest equality uses ordinary string comparison.","evidence":"release_policy.py:14 compares digests with != rather than hmac.compare_digest.","claim_ids":["x1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Paths and roots are not validated as non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16-18 accepts roots and paths without validation; an empty root matches every path.","claim_ids":["x2","x5"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Root containment uses a raw string prefix.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 allows path 'foobar/file' under root 'foo'.","claim_ids":["x3"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Rename sources are never checked.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 reads only change['path'], so a rename from an out-of-scope source can pass.","claim_ids":["x4"]},{"finding_id":"f5","severity":"blocking","summary":"Malformed records and unknown actions do not reliably fail closed.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 raises KeyError for a record without 'path' and never examines an action field.","claim_ids":["x5"]}]}
